sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A large evergreen conifer of wet tropical forests in eastern Queensland, New Guinea and the Bismarck Archipelago. It has a straight trunk and leathery leaves. Australian references report about 20–50 m tall, with a crown spread up to 18 m. Female cones break apart at maturity to release winged seeds.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: Its timber has been harvested. Human food use was not established in the sources consulted.
